name: Monuments of Millions of Years
description: You raised two great wonders. A pharaoh who builds for eternity has taken notice.

name: A Colony over the Sea
description: You founded a third harbor town. Colonists ask an oikist to lead them west.

name: The Eastern Capital
description: Your greatest city reached ten population. A regent offers to make it a capital worthy of Heaven.

name: The Conquest of Awsan
description: You captured a city. A South Arabian ruler carves your victories into stone.

name: Queen of Kings
description: You have sent sixteen envoys abroad. A queen who speaks to every court comes to yours.

name: A Realm of Eight Cities
description: Your realm grew to eight settlements. A young king dreams of carrying it to the ends of the earth.

name: The Treasure Fleet
description: You had four ships on the water at once. An admiral asks to lead them across the ocean.

name: The Siege of Palmyra
description: You held a city through a five-turn siege. A desert queen admires such defiance.

name: The Land-Taking
description: You settled twenty-five tiles of the cold northern forests. A settler throws his high-seat pillars into the sea and follows them to you.

name: The Vinland Voyage
description: You have explored two-fifths of the world. A Greenlander wants to see what lies beyond it.

name: The Thule Migration
description: Your camps spread over twelve tundra tiles. Pathfinders who crossed the Arctic in a few generations join you.

name: Winter on the Ice
description: You hold ten tiles in the polar north. Builders of snow houses show you how to live on the sea ice.

name: The Great Conquest
description: You have captured five cities. A khan who united the steppe rides to your banner.

name: A Host of Horse Archers
description: You fielded five cavalry units at once. A smith's son who led armies from China to Hungary takes command.

name: The Lusitanian War
description: You have won twelve battles. A shepherd who beat Rome for eight years offers his spear.

name: The School of Translators
description: You have refined traditions from three different cultures. A king who gathered the learning of three faiths joins your court.
